nodes.label: FillCmdPacket Test Mode Command Flow
nodes.rationale: Sender listens FILL_CMD_WAIT_MS (60 ms) after each acked packet so commands reach a deep-sleeping sender; state echoed via FILL_FLAG_TESTMODE bit; lost commands are retried.

nodes.label: 4 MB Partition Layout (2x1.75 MB OTA + LittleFS)
nodes.norm_label: 4 mb partition layout (2x1.75 mb ota + littlefs)
nodes.rationale: Firmware ~1.2 MB fills 92% of default 1.25 MB slot; custom table gives 1.75 MB per app slot.

nodes.norm_label: sender offline detection (3 x interval + 60 s)

nodes.label: System Overview (Sender -> Receiver -> Home Assistant)
nodes.rationale: Sender only measures and sleeps; receiver holds tank geometry and computes values; radio channel follows the home WLAN channel.

nodes.label: Classic ESP32 (WROOM-32) Target
nodes.rationale: ESP32-C3/C6 lack GPIO 34/33/25 in the same form, so switching would require pin and wakeup logic changes.

nodes.label: Battery Runtime Estimate (10 min interval)
nodes.rationale: ~3.35 mAh/day; 18650 lasts ~1 year realistically; 30 min interval triples runtime.

nodes.label: uPesy ESP32 Wroom Low Power DevKit
nodes.norm_label: upesy esp32 wroom low power devkit

nodes.label: VL53L1X ToF Distance Sensor
nodes.rationale: Use breakout with efficient regulator and no permanent LED (e.g. Pololu); GY-53 modules with own MCU draw continuous current.

nodes.label: Captive Portal (Fuellstand-Anzeige AP)
nodes.rationale: Portal is restricted to WiFi configuration; /fill and OTA only in home WLAN.

nodes.label: FillLevelProtocol.h Data Packet
nodes.rationale: Must be kept identical in sender and receiver; packets with wrong length are discarded.

nodes.label: MQTT Home Assistant Auto-Discovery
nodes.rationale: One HA device per container; id = fuellstand_ + last 3 MAC bytes, legacy 1.0 container keeps old ID so HA history survives.

nodes.label: Visual Micro Build Property Overrides
nodes.rationale: Forces custom partitions.csv and LittleFS upload; mklittlefs path is hard-coded to one user and must be adapted on other machines.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before raw grep/reads to get a scoped subgraph with fewer tokens; run graphify update after code changes.

nodes.label: Receiver Board Recommendation (Mains Powered DevKit)
nodes.rationale: Power consumption irrelevant; needs 4 MB flash for 2 OTA slots + LittleFS, GPIO 21/22 for OLED, WROOM-32U for external antenna at range.

nodes.label: Sender Board Recommendation (Low Deep-Sleep Current)
nodes.rationale: Standard DevKits draw 5-15 mA in deep sleep (USB-UART, AMS1117, power LED), draining an 18650 in 2-3 weeks.

nodes.label: ElegantOTA ELEGANTOTA_USE_ASYNC_WEBSERVER Patch
nodes.rationale: #define in the .ino only affects the sketch; library compiled with default 0 causes undefined reference to ElegantOTAClass::begin(AsyncWebServer*). Library header must be edited; change is lost on library update.

nodes.label: Open Portal WLAN (AP_PASS empty)
nodes.rationale: Security trade-off: anyone in range can configure WiFi while portal is active; set AP_PASS (>=8 chars) to restore a password.

nodes.label: AP mode captive portal (WLAN-only setup)
nodes.rationale: In AP mode the start page offers only WiFi configuration; project pages (/fill) and firmware update (/update) are only available in home WLAN (STA) via indexSTA.html.

nodes.label: Stored password never served (empty = unchanged while SSID same)
nodes.norm_label: stored password never served (empty = unchanged while ssid same)
nodes.rationale: /api/ap/config returns hasPassword instead of the password; legacy settingsAP.html still reads password from /config.json.

nodes.label: SSID rendered via textContent (XSS guard)
nodes.rationale: SSIDs are foreign input; newer pages use textContent, legacy settingsAP.html still uses innerHTML with n.ssid.
